$comment: Tenant-data entry points that do NOT reference the tenant lifecycle vocabulary. Each needs a justification saying why the surface does not need an entitlement check. This list may only SHRINK: wire the check, then re-run with --write-baseline. Adding an entry by hand is a regression, not a fix.

server/jobs/auditChainIntegritySweep.ts.reason: DELIBERATELY UNCONDITIONAL. Verifies the tamper-evident audit hash chain estate-wide (zero organization_id references; runs under a system scope). Audit integrity is precisely the thing that must NOT stop when a tenant is suspended, pending deletion or purged — 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e) expects the trail to outlive the records it describes. Gating this on entitlement would blind the platform to chain damage in exactly the tenants under scrutiny.

server/jobs/corpusIngestionSweep.ts.reason: NO PER-TENANT FAN-OUT. Zero organization_id references; ingests into the shared regulatory corpus under a system scope. Nothing here is attributable to a tenant, so there is no tenant to be entitled. Revisit if it gains per-tenant fan-out — the content digest below will re-flag it.

server/jobs/driftSentinelSweep.ts.reason: NO PER-TENANT FAN-OUT. Zero organization_id references; estate-wide drift detection under a system scope. Revisit if it gains per-tenant fan-out — the digest will re-flag it.

server/jobs/externalIntelligenceSweep.ts.reason: NO PER-TENANT FAN-OUT. Zero organization_id references; ingests shared external intelligence under a system scope. Revisit if it gains per-tenant fan-out — the digest will re-flag it.

server/jobs/regulatoryHorizonScan.ts.reason: NO PER-TENANT FAN-OUT. Zero organization_id references; scans the shared regulatory horizon under a system scope. Revisit if it gains per-tenant fan-out — the digest will re-flag it.

server/jobs/retentionCron.ts.reason: DELIBERATELY UNCONDITIONAL. Retention deletion must run FOR non-entitled tenants — that is its purpose. A suspended or pending-deletion tenant is the primary case, and gating it on entitlement would mean data is never retained out of the tenants whose retention clock is actually running. Its only notification path (notifyAdmins) addresses PLATFORM admins with an estate summary, not tenant users.

server/jobs/scheduleOfEventsSweep.ts.reason: NO PER-TENANT FAN-OUT at the sweep level: zero organization_id references, runs under a system scope. NOTE — the RLS burndown lists this as a writer, so if it ever selects per-organization it needs filterTenantsForBackgroundWork like taskDueSweep. The digest below is what forces that re-read.

server/routes/api-keys.ts.reason: FALSE POSITIVE of the shape matcher (matches on the string 'validateApiKey'). This is the session-authenticated router for MANAGING keys, mounted under /api behind the auth boundary, so enforceTenantLifecycle already covers it. It is not itself an alternative-auth surface.

server/routes/mdx-admin.ts.reason: FALSE POSITIVE (matches on the word 'SCIM' in prose). Mounted at /api/mdx, behind the auth boundary, so the lifecycle guard already covers it.
